_about: Capability bands for the site generator (site_gen.config reads 'capability' and 'modes'). Version 3, 2026-11-14 11:00 EST, for the gait firmware of the build stage (gait/rl_controller.py: step guard, slip-aware stall check, walk body height 0.24-0.26 m). Every number below was measured (MuJoCo 3.14.0) with obstacles built like site_gen's, element turned U(-20, 20) degrees, commanded speed over the mode's whole range, in three result sets. The measured tables are in manual_tables.json.

_robot.note: Camera (head tilt axis) 0.055 m above the body origin and 0.165 m ahead of it. Measured camera height walking: walk 0.299 m (body 0.242), high_step 0.316 (0.257), crouch_walk 0.245 (0.190); standing 0.204-0.314 m for body heights 0.15-0.26. Lidar top 0.081 m above the body origin.

_manual_notes_for_programs: Walk and crouch_walk stop with 'blocked' (reason 'step') when a foot comes down more than 3 cm above its previous foothold: they refuse sills and kerbs from 4 cm and hoses and floor pipes from 5 cm, and cross 3 cm and below.
On 15 degree ramps walk at 0.30 m/s or slower (faster, the step guard stops it at the foot of the ramp in a third of first tries).
A 'blocked' at rated sizes is a real slow-down (less than 15 percent of the commanded progress for 2.5 s in high_step, 25 percent for 1.5 s in walk): retry up to twice in the same mode.
The stall check measures progress with the IMU as well as the legs: treading in place on a slippery floor or against an obstacle ends in 'blocked' (reason 'slip').
Status returns to 'ok' when the robot starts walking again after a 'blocked'.
Ramped cable protectors are not refused reliably by walk (43-50 of 60 first tries at 4-6 cm): do not use them as needs_high_step elements.
